title: Stocks held 20 years: 0 of 53 lost
description:
A model said 3%. Reality was 0 of 53. US stocks held for twenty years never lost real money from 1951 on. Model fitted on 1871 to 1950.
Lesson: https://mba.rimilab.com/#/mba/risk-return
Data: Robert Shiller via Datahub s-and-p-500 (ODC-PDDL). History, not advice.
